name: prompt-master
tagline_zh: 写提示词总被AI带偏？让它帮你把需求炼成精准咒语，适配Cursor、Midjourney等工具，连视频AI都能调教。
tagline_en: Tired of vague AI replies? Turn your needs into precise spells for Cursor, Midjourney, video AI, and more.
desc_en: Generates optimized prompts for AI tools. Activates only when the user explicitly asks to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool (LLM, Cursor, Midjourney, image AI, video AI, coding agents, etc.). Does not activate for general conversation, coding tasks, document writing, or other non-prompt-engineering work.
why_zh: 只在你要写/改提示词时出手，不抢戏；针对具体工具定制，而非通用模板。
why_en: Activates only when you craft prompts, tailored per tool—not a generic template.
